Design-only brief: a vanilla JavaScript receiving portal has three roles: admin, checker, supplier. Checker marks a delivery as not received. Current screen always requests a free-text reason after any reason selection. Proposed reasons: closed shop, missing documents, other. Only other requires free text. Existing records must remain readable. No new dependencies or analytics. Prepare a concise actionable plan with acceptance criteria and edge cases, do not implement or deploy. No screenshots or browser runtime are available.
